title: refactor(update): inject installMethod and skillDiscoverer to enable t.Parallel()
description:
## What does this MR do and why?

Closes #8789.

Refactors test seams in `internal/commands/update` to eliminate package-level mutable globals:
- Removes package globals `installMethodDetector` in `check_update.go` and `discoverInstalled` in `skill_updates.go`.
- Introduces functional `CheckUpdateOption`s (`WithInstallMethodDetector`, `WithSkillDiscoverer`) for `NewCheckUpdateCmd`, `CheckUpdate`, and `CheckUpdateExplicit`.
- Allows passing an optional discoverer to `bundledSkillUpdates` and `remoteSkillUpdates`, defaulting cleanly to `installed.Discover`.
- Refactors `check_update_test.go` and `skill_updates_test.go` to use direct dependency injection and enables `t.Parallel()`.

### Related issues
Resolves #8789. Follow-up to !4429.

title: Draft: [FixPipeline] https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/pipelines/3087210765
description:
I fixed the three SHA-1 panics that caused the `tests:fips` failure. Locally, `internal/commands/df/dfcmd` and `internal/dependencyfirewall/pm` now pass in FIPS-only mode and in normal mode. I did not get a fully clean `make test-fips` run, because the sandbox adds failures that don't come from the code. Re-run the CI job to confirm. ## Cause The test helpers build PKCS#12 fixtures with `pkcs12.Modern.Encode`. That function calls `crypto/sha1.Sum`, which panics under `GODEBUG=fips140=only`. I did not use option A because `Modern` is the same encoder as `Modern2023`, and v0.7.4 still hashes with SHA-1 on that path. I wrapped each `Encode` call in `fips140.WithoutEnforcement`, the same approach the MR already used in `position.go` and `sync.go`. Only test fixtures are affected, not production code. ## What was run - **First `make test-fips` after the fix:** it reported 45 failures, down from 253, and the SHA-1 panics were gone. - **Remaining failures:** these were in `internal/config`, `auth/login`, `cmdutils`, `cmd/glab`, `stack/save`, `orbit` and `api`. They come from sandbox environment variables such as `GLAB_CONFIG_DIR` and from the git author identity. - **Rerun without those variables:** only two sets of failures remained in the packages I rechecked. - `stack/save` `Test_commitFiles` fails because git prints an `Author:` line in the commit output. - `TestNewClientFromConfigProxy/configured_proxy` in `internal/api` fails. It fails identically without FIPS settings, so it is not caused by this change. I did not investigate why. - **Not rechecked:** I did not rerun the full `make test-fips` with the environment cleared, so the other packages from the first run (`cmdutils`, `auth/login`, `cmd/glab` and so on) were not re-verified. ## Unrelated, for review The MR's `.goreleaser.yml` change adds `ids: [foo]` to both `dockers` entries and `ids: [linux]` to `nfpms`, and removes an explanatory comment. It looks like a leftover and may break docker or nfpm packaging at release time. I left it alone. ## Files modified - `internal/api/client_cert_test.go` - `internal/commands/df/dfcmd/dfcmd_test.go` - `internal/dependencyfirewall/pm/jvmupstreamtrust_test.go` Fixes [failing pipeline](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/-/pipelines/3087210765)
